meta.name: The Conquering Power
meta.description:
From the Wikipedia entry for "The Conquering Power":

"The Conquering Power is a silent film made in 1921, directed by Rex Ingram and starring Rudolph Valentino, Alice Terry, and Ralph Lewis. It was based on the novel Eugénie Grandet by Honoré de Balzac."

Original text can be found at http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Conquering_Power
License terms may be found at http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/

You can find more information regarding this film on its IMDb page
